name: Kapre
description: A tall, dark tree giant said to sit in old balete trees smoking a big cigar: more mischievous than cruel.
note: The kapre comes from Tagalog and other lowland folklore. Stories differ from place to place; this game shows it resting, never as a monster to fight.
sources: Maximo D. Ramos, The Creatures of Philippine Lower Mythology (University of the Philippines Press, 1971)
